column1: # Weak services per Raspberry Pi role (MASTERPLAN §4.1). Single source of truth for
# setup.sh and labctl. Tab-separated. "default" = on in the starting lab (score 25).
# The default lab is two Pis, camera + hub (#128). server is an optional third device:
# nothing on by default, so it adds 0 points until a toggle is switched on.
# kind: fake = lab/fakes/fakesvc.py under systemd; real = a locked-down real daemon;
#       identity = no service, the Pi's own identity (random MAC, no hostname).
